title: Father & Children with Rabbit, Easter Yard - Vintage 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A sunny outdoor mid-century family snapshot, likely taken around Easter. An affectionate father in slacks and an open-collar shirt leans against a tree trunk alongside an older boy holding a live white rabbit. To the left, a small toddler clutching a woven basket looks up adoringly at his father, while a young girl in a polka-dot dress stands partially in shadow to the right. The backyard setting features trimmed hedges and a bare tree against bright sunlight, capturing a classic scene of American post-war domestic life.
